reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29 against Hermetica's July 2026 custodian attestation, published 2026-08-03: at 07:00 UTC on 2026-07-31, USDh supply was $1,994,097.68; Ethereum Settlement Wallet was $1,996,626.39, Stacks Redeeming Reserve $8,037.52, Reserve Fund $110,600.24 (USDC $100,148.12 and USDh $10,452.12), and Copper, Ceffu, and Mint Wallet were $0.00. Including the Reserve Fund, total reported backing was $2,115,264.15; normalized venue weights are 94.4%, 0.4%, 4.7%, and 0.5%. The attestation does not itemize the Ethereum Settlement Wallet (94.4%) or Stacks Redeeming Reserve (0.4%), including BTC basis margin, short futures, STRC/STRCx credit exposure, and settlement stablecoins. The Reserve Fund USDh portion is circular protocol self-exposure.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Hermetica July 2026 custodian attestation (2026-07-31 07:00 UTC snapshot) with venue weights normalized to total reported backing
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The attestation reports venue-level totals but does not itemize the contents of the Ethereum Settlement Wallet (94.4%) or the Stacks Redeeming Reserve (0.4%), including the current spot BTC, short-futures, STRC-route, and stablecoin shares or venue-level counterparty weights.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Hermetica's monthly custodian attestations identify the venue-level allocation (Copper, Ceffu, Stacks Redeeming Reserve, Ethereum Settlement Wallet, Reserve Fund) but do not publish per-venue contents, account-level segregation, or insolvency terms; the STRC disclosures name Galaxy (execution) and Clear Street (custody) for the Saturn USDat route and Backed Assets (JE) Limited/Kraken for STRCx without disclosing shares; collateral is actively deployed as futures margin and credit exposure, so reuse within the strategy is inherent.
